title: Transfiguration, 2026
description: A sequence of developmental states compressed into a single organism, where emergence, decay, protection, and growth occur simultaneously. The surrounding membrane functions as a regulatory interface: a temporary structure that isolates the body from external pressures while allowing profound internal reorganization to take place. Within the framework of Adaptive Flesh, the chrysalis is understood not as a symbol of rebirth, but as a technology of adaptation — a protective system through which the body acquires the capacity to navigate changing realities.
